image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on a grey, textured surface. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head featuring greyish mottling, a bright orange-rufous breast and belly, and black upperparts with distinct white wing bars and shoulder patches. The bill is short, conical, and dark. The legs are visible, appearing pinkish-brown, gripping the ground.
